CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 09 / 11

Supply elasticity and applications

Elasticity and shock size彈性與衝擊反應

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Apply elasticity to shifts: explain how the size of a price or quantity response depends on the elasticity of the curve being moved along.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

一條曲線移動時，另一條線的彈性影響新均衡。相同供給衝擊下，需求較缺乏彈性通常令價格變較多、數量變較少。

After a curve shifts, the elasticity of the other curve shapes the price and quantity adjustment. A less responsive demand curve generally produces a larger price change and smaller quantity change for a comparable supply shock.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A supply cut in essential fuel can cause a sharp price rise in the short run when demand barely responds. 短期必需燃料難以減用。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Same supply reduction, which demand gives the larger price rise? 同樣供給減少，哪種需求令價升較多？
